system.description:
A collapsible stand bearing extremely fine bells, suspended threads and weighted needles. It does not detect spirits. Instead, it reveals tiny movements of air, vibration or surfaces. It grants a +1-item bonus to Interpret Haunt only when the haunt produces a physical manifestation capable of disturbing the apparatus.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

goodsConditionals.label: a physical manifestation
goodsConditionals.scope: Interpret Haunt when the haunt produces a physical manifestation
